before_start: Read prd/PRD.md §0 (MVP-R) and pick one task with status pending; prefer critical > high > medium > low, then lowest task id
Ensure dependency tasks are done before starting
during_work: One task per session when possible; small commits to main
Tenant isolation: every Prisma query in Server Actions must filter by tenantId from the session
UI copy uses Team; code/DB uses Tenant
Stop and ask the human for credentials or external account setup — no fake secrets
before_finish: Mark status done in this file when acceptance_criteria are met
Append one short line to progress.md (optional, not a detailed report)
Do not add test_steps to tasks

meta.stack: Next.js App Router, Prisma, Supabase Auth, Vercel Blob, Stripe (free/paid)
meta.tenancy_terminology: Tenant in code/DB; Team in UI

tasks.description: Create Next.js 15+ App Router project at repo root (or apps/web) with TypeScript strict mode and path aliases.
acceptance_criteria: npm run dev serves the app locally
App Router app/ directory with root layout and a placeholder home route
README lists required env vars at a high level

tasks.description: Install and configure Tailwind CSS 3.4+ and shadcn/ui with the existing Teamhub light theme (bright, professional; slate/neutral palette per PRD vision).
acceptance_criteria: tailwind.config and globals.css define light theme defaults
At least Button, Input, Card, Label components from shadcn are usable
Home page demonstrates consistent typography and spacing on desktop width

tasks.description: Add Prisma with PostgreSQL datasource pointing at Supabase; initial migrate workflow documented in README.
acceptance_criteria: prisma/schema.prisma exists with generator client
prisma migrate dev works against a configured DATABASE_URL
@prisma/client generated on install/build

tasks.description: Prisma models Tenant and User: User.id is UUID PK matching auth.users.id; fields include tenantId, email, name, role (ADMIN | WORKER), isActive.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant has id, name, plan (FREE | PAID), stripeCustomerId optional, createdAt
User belongs to Tenant; role enum matches §0.4
Migration applied successfully

tasks.description: Wire Supabase Auth for email/password: browser client, server client, and service-role admin helper for invites.
acceptance_criteria: Env vars documented: SUPABASE_URL, anon key, service role key
lib/supabase helpers for server and client components
No public signup route — login and invite acceptance only

tasks.description: Login page at /login with email/password form and error states; redirect authenticated users to app home.
acceptance_criteria: Unauthenticated users can sign in with valid Supabase credentials
Invalid credentials show a clear message
Successful login lands on /app (or equivalent dashboard route)

tasks.description: Route protection middleware: require session for /app/*; load Prisma User row and attach tenantId + role to request context for Server Actions.
acceptance_criteria: /app routes return redirect to /login when logged out
Server Actions can read current user id, tenantId, role
Missing Prisma profile for auth user shows a friendly blocked state

tasks.description: Responsive app shell: sidebar navigation on md+ screens; bottom nav or collapsible drawer on small screens; same routes for all roles.
acceptance_criteria: Shell includes nav links placeholders for Jobs, Customers, Calendar, Board, Team, Settings
Layout readable on 390px width and 1440px width
User can sign out from the shell

tasks.description: PWA basics: web manifest, theme-color, apple-touch-icon, and service worker strategy suitable for Vercel (installable on mobile).
acceptance_criteria: manifest.json names the app and defines icons
Mobile browser offers Add to Home Screen where supported
Standalone display does not break app routing

tasks.description: Shared auth helpers: hasRole(user, roles[]) and assertTenantAccess(tenantId) used across Server Actions.
acceptance_criteria: Single module exported for role checks
ADMIN-only helper used by billing/settings actions
No duplicate ad-hoc role string comparisons in more than one pattern file

tasks.description: Prisma Customer model: tenant-scoped contact fields (name, phone, email optional, company optional, notes optional).
acceptance_criteria: Customer has tenantId FK and timestamps
Migration applied
Indexes on tenantId for list queries

tasks.description: Prisma Job model with §0.6 statuses as string/enum, customerId, assignedUserId optional, schedule fields, address/lat/lng, vehicleMake/Model/Year, pendingReason, manual price fields, customFields Json optional.
acceptance_criteria: All MVP statuses representable including Submitted pool state
Job links to Customer and optional assignee User
Migration applied

tasks.description: Prisma JobStatusHistory, JobNote, JobPhoto models per §0.
acceptance_criteria: JobStatusHistory stores fromStatus, toStatus, changedById, createdAt
JobNote has body text, authorId, jobId
JobPhoto stores blobUrl, jobId, uploadedById, createdAt

tasks.description: Server Actions: list, create, update customers with tenantId filter.
acceptance_criteria: CRUD operations scope to session tenantId
Validation errors return usable messages to the UI

tasks.description: Customers list page with search by name/phone and link to detail.
acceptance_criteria: Table or card list works on mobile and desktop
Empty state when no customers
New customer CTA opens create flow

tasks.description: Customer detail page showing contact info and linked jobs list.
acceptance_criteria: Shows customer fields and edit action
Lists jobs for this customer in the tenant

tasks.description: Server Actions: create, update, list, get job by id with tenantId filter; no state machine — status is a direct field update.
acceptance_criteria: Any WORKER or ADMIN can create and update jobs
Updates never cross tenants
List supports filter by status

tasks.description: On job status change, append JobStatusHistory row with from/to and changedById.
acceptance_criteria: History written whenever status field changes
Initial create can log null → Submitted or first status set

tasks.description: Jobs list page with status chips and quick link to detail; highlight Submitted pool jobs.
acceptance_criteria: All tenant jobs visible to every member
Pool jobs visually distinct (e.g. accent border/badge)
Responsive layout

tasks.description: Job create/edit form: customer picker, title/description, schedule start/end, status select, pending reason when Pending.
acceptance_criteria: Can create job tied to existing customer
Manual price/amount fields editable (no quoting engine)
Form usable on mobile

tasks.description: Google Places Autocomplete on job address field; on select fill address, lat, lng inputs.
acceptance_criteria: NEXT_PUBLIC_GOOGLE_MAPS_API_KEY documented
Selected place persists to Job on save
Works on mobile browsers

tasks.description: Static vehicles.json and cascading Make → Model → Year selects; save plain columns on Job.
acceptance_criteria: lib/constants/vehicles.json bundled in repo
Client-side filtering only; no API for options
Values persist on job save

tasks.description: Job detail page with status control, assignee picker, address summary, and status history timeline.
acceptance_criteria: Free status change from detail view
History list shows recent transitions
Map link or static map preview from lat/lng optional but no PostGIS

tasks.description: Shared pool view: filter Submitted jobs; Claim action sets status to Assigned and optional assignee to current user.
acceptance_criteria: Claim updates job in one action
Pool empty state shown when none
Works on mobile PWA

tasks.description: Job notes: add note Server Action and list on job detail.
acceptance_criteria: Notes ordered newest first
Author name or email shown
Any tenant member can add notes

tasks.description: Vercel Blob upload from Server Action or signed client upload; store JobPhoto row with URL.
acceptance_criteria: BLOB_READ_WRITE_TOKEN documented
Upload accepts image types common from phone camera
Photos scoped to tenant via job relation

tasks.description: Job photos UI: gallery on detail, upload button, mobile-friendly file/camera input.
acceptance_criteria: Thumbnails load from Blob URLs
Upload progress or loading state shown
Touch targets adequate on small screens

tasks.description: Calendar page: month/week view of jobs by scheduledStart on desktop; compact agenda list on mobile.
acceptance_criteria: Click job opens detail
Jobs without schedule appear in unscheduled section or filter
Responsive breakpoints

tasks.description: Kanban board: columns per status; cards show customer name and schedule; change status from card menu or drag if feasible.
acceptance_criteria: All §0.6 columns represented
Status update persists via Server Action
Horizontal scroll on mobile acceptable

tasks.description: Team page: list members in tenant with role badges.
acceptance_criteria: Shows name, email, role, active state
ADMIN sees invite button; WORKER read-only list

tasks.description: ADMIN invite flow: Supabase invite email + create Prisma User with role and tenantId.
acceptance_criteria: Invite specifies WORKER or ADMIN
Invited user can set password and land in app with correct tenant
Duplicate email handled gracefully

tasks.description: ADMIN deactivate member (isActive false); deactivated users cannot use app.
acceptance_criteria: Deactivated user blocked at middleware or session check
Cannot deactivate self if sole admin (simple guard)

tasks.description: Team settings page (ADMIN): edit team display name.
acceptance_criteria: WORKER cannot access settings route
Name updates Tenant record

tasks.description: Stripe: create/sync Customer on tenant; store stripeCustomerId; env vars for keys documented.
acceptance_criteria: ADMIN trigger or lazy-create Stripe customer for tenant
Test mode keys documented in README

tasks.description: Stripe Checkout or Payment Link for upgrading tenant FREE → PAID (single paid price id).
acceptance_criteria: ADMIN can start upgrade from billing page
Success return URL shows updated plan intent

tasks.description: Stripe Customer Portal link for ADMIN to manage subscription.
acceptance_criteria: Portal session created server-side
Return URL returns to billing page

tasks.description: Stripe webhook route: checkout.session.completed and customer.subscription.updated set tenant plan FREE or PAID.
acceptance_criteria: Signature verification implemented
Idempotent handling of duplicate events
No seat or job count limits enforced

tasks.description: Billing page (ADMIN): current plan, upgrade CTA, portal link.
acceptance_criteria: WORKER receives 403 or redirect
Plan label matches Tenant.plan

tasks.description: Detect jobs in Submitted status older than 5 minutes; surface in-app alert for ADMIN users.
acceptance_criteria: Alert visible in app shell (badge or banner)
Implementation uses polling or Supabase Realtime — no push
Dismiss or snooze optional but not required

tasks.description: Sentry for Next.js client and server with environment tags.
acceptance_criteria: DSN via env var
Test error route or documented manual verification
PII not sent in custom context

tasks.description: App home dashboard: counts open jobs, pool count, today schedule snippet.
acceptance_criteria: Cards link to Jobs, Pool, Calendar
Loads with tenant-scoped queries only

tasks.description: Global loading skeletons and empty states for main list pages.
acceptance_criteria: Jobs, Customers, Calendar, Board show skeleton while loading
Consistent with light theme

tasks.description: app/error.tsx and not-found UX with navigation back to home.
acceptance_criteria: Friendly copy using Team terminology
Recoverable link to /app

tasks.description: Invite acceptance route: set password for invited Supabase user and ensure Prisma profile exists.
acceptance_criteria: Works from email link flow
Redirects to /app after success

tasks.description: Password reset flow using Supabase reset email and update-password page.
acceptance_criteria: Forgot password link on login
Reset completes and user can sign in

tasks.description: Job list quick filters: pool only, assigned to me, by status.
acceptance_criteria: Filters combine with tenant list query
State reflected in URL query params optional

tasks.description: Document local dev bootstrap: Supabase project, first tenant/user SQL example, env template .env.example.
acceptance_criteria: .env.example lists all keys without secrets
README section explains manual onboarding per §0.3

tasks.description: Vercel deployment config: build command, Prisma generate, production env checklist.
acceptance_criteria: Project builds on Vercel with documented steps
Blob and Stripe webhook URLs noted for production setup
